C-62.IntentSummary: Sequential implementation of the approved per-diagram appearance mock, with portable metadata, local CSS palettes, accessible menu, viewer/export parity and regression evidence.

T-001.Title: Implement and verify safe source metadata and appearance policy

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Source preservation, safe colors, parsing limits and shared DOM policy are covered by deterministic tests.

T-002.Title: Wire the accessible editor menu, history, cache and viewer/export parity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Four-mode UI, read-only choices, history and viewer/export policy pass focused tests; all ten locales contain native copy.

T-003.Title: Review corners, exercise browser behavior and reconcile durable evidence

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Review, full renderer suite, frontend build and Chromium/WebKit checks pass; graph/verification/contracts describe the final implementation.

C-62.Approval: The user's explicit implementation approval covers this feature and routine plan/execution choices; execute sequentially without a repeated approval prompt.
C-62.BaselineEvidence: 2026-10-18: current lint reports exactly three pre-existing C-55 obsolete baseline assertions. C-57 and C-60 work already exists in the shared checkout and is preserved.

Review.Method: Source/contract review, real Muya history/export tests and browser computed-style/focus/geometry checks; sequential execution.

ResolvedFinding.Risk: The global search keyup handler could steal focus after the menu consumed Escape on keydown.
ResolvedFinding.Fix: The menu owns handled keys through release, with a bounded cleanup timer and destroy cleanup.
ResolvedFinding.Verification: Real Muya keyup ownership assertion and Chromium/WebKit inline/viewer focus checks.

ResolvedFinding.Risk: An obsolete asynchronous render could overwrite a newer source, or a removed live target could resolve to the fullscreen clone sharing its id.
ResolvedFinding.Fix: Latest-source checks and editor-scoped target resolution.
ResolvedFinding.Verification: Delayed-loader supersession and removed-target/viewer-clone pipeline regressions.

ResolvedFinding.Risk: Undo or a source update while the viewer stayed open could leave its colors and mode stale.
ResolvedFinding.Fix: Subscribe to content changes as well as appearance/options; refresh the live clone while retaining pan/zoom.
ResolvedFinding.Verification: Chromium/WebKit viewer choice, undo, colors, button state and zoom checks.

ResolvedFinding.Risk: The editor's opaque SVG background hid the author background, and controls could overlap a short diagram.
ResolvedFinding.Fix: Apply local background to the SVG itself; reserve control space above content and keep chrome in the document theme.
ResolvedFinding.Verification: Browser computed SVG backgrounds and control-to-SVG bounds; export background and Auto cleanup assertions; screenshot review.

ResolvedFinding.Risk: On unlock the logical view override expired lazily, leaving its old colors on screen.
ResolvedFinding.Fix: Observe readonly-attribute changes; clear and redraw temporary choices without content/history writes, notify the viewer, and disconnect on teardown.
ResolvedFinding.Verification: Automatic reset in the real Muya test and Chromium/WebKit unlock checks, including unchanged buffer metadata and subsequent typing.

Review.Corners: Pending human edits remain a separate undo step; metadata maps source selections; readonly overrides expire on source change/unlock; nested and duplicate fences export independently; removed figures and teardown are safe; disabled Custom and keyboard navigation work in a narrow viewport.
Review.Limitations: Custom bridges the documented literal-hex semantic/series colors and existing inline colors. It does not recreate arbitrary Mermaid theme variables, named themes, fonts or geometry.

Evidence.Locales: All ten locale JSON files contain eleven nonempty native strings and match their minified copies; existing C-57 translations are preserved.

T-001.Result: Safe source metadata, YAML/init palette parsing, mode fallback, inline paint normalization and SVG backgrounds are covered by real-Pele policy tests.

T-002.Result: Menu/history/read-only/controller, pipeline and export tests pass: 53 tests across the four selected target files.

T-003.Result: Final serial full renderer suite: 310 files, 4140 passed, 2 skipped, 3 todo, exit 0 without teardown errors. Frontend build passes. Final browser feature checks: 12/12 in Chromium and WebKit, including computed backgrounds, control clearance, fresh parse, undo, lock/unlock and subsequent typing, mirror state, cache reuse, viewport bounds and viewer zoom/focus. Narrow menu and viewer screenshots inspected.

Evidence.Grace: Selected target gate with command evidence: 0 errors. Final gate runs the current 53-test target successfully and reports exactly the same 3 pre-existing C-55 obsolete baseline assertions (deleted mermaidPipeline.js, deleted mermaidTheme.js, removed Mermaid dependency). No new C-62 structural or assertion failures.
Evidence.ViewerRegression: Existing block-viewer.spec.ts passes all 34 scenarios across Chromium and WebKit: diagrams/tables, narrow/large content, need gates, keyboard/Tab focus, copy-icon style, viewport resize, fit/actual size, global theme refresh and active-source layout.
